question: Frederick and Justina spend $8/$16 per day, leaving Justina $70; swapping spending gives Justina $430. Find their parent-given amounts.
hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Read the two aligned case bars as equal money units: the change from the first case to the second leaves 3 equal units between $70 and $430.

steps.title: Compare the two case bars
steps.text: The top bar shows Frederick:Justina = 1:2 and the lower bar shows 2:1. Matching the fixed end segment of $70 to the $430 comparison leaves 3 equal unit blocks.

steps.title: Value one unit
steps.text: The 3 blocks represent $430 − $70 = $360, so 1 unit is $360 ÷ 3 = $120.

steps.title: Read each amount from the bars
steps.text: Frederick has 2 units, or 2 × $120 = $240. Justina has the $430 segment plus 1 unit, or $430 + $120 = $550.

en.answerCheck: Check: the 3-unit gap is 3 × $120 = $360 = $430 − $70. Answer: Frederick: $240; Justina: $550.

question: Tank A:B water was 4:3. Adding 0.8 L filled A, making A 2 times B. A capacity was 1/4 of B capacity. How much more water fills B?
hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the segmented tank bars: A has 6 equal units when full, and its final 2-unit segment is 0.8 L.

steps.title: Label the equal units in tank A
steps.text: The 2 shaded units added to A are 0.8 L, so 1 unit is 0.8 ÷ 2 = 0.4 L. All 6 units in full tank A are 6 × 0.4 = 2.4 L.

steps.title: Scale to tank B
steps.text: The capacity bar for B has 4 quarters, with A's 2.4 L as 1 quarter. So B holds 4 × 2.4 = 9.6 L, while its 3 water units are 3 × 0.4 = 1.2 L.

steps.title: Use B's unshaded part
steps.text: The unshaded amount needed to fill B is 9.6 − 1.2 = 8.4 L.

en.answerCheck: Check: B has 1.2 L of its 9.6 L capacity, leaving 8.4 L. Answer: 8.4 L.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用分格水箱条：A装满时有6个等份，而A最后增加的2份是0.8 L。

steps.title: 标出A的等份
steps.text: A增加的2个阴影格是0.8 L，所以1格是0.8 ÷ 2 = 0.4 L。装满的A有6格，即6 × 0.4 = 2.4 L。

steps.title: 按比例求B
steps.text: B的容量条分成4个四分之一，其中1份等于A的2.4 L。因此B容量为4 × 2.4 = 9.6 L；B已有的3个水量格为3 × 0.4 = 1.2 L。

steps.title: 读出B的留白部分
steps.text: 填满B所需的留白量是9.6 − 1.2 = 8.4 L。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：B已有1.2 L，容量是9.6 L，剩下8.4 L。答案：8.4 L。

steps.title: Add the blocks shown for the final total
steps.text: The final bar has 8 equal units and the $210 fixed amount, so its total is 8 × $18 + $210 = $354.

question: 3 books + 2 magazines cost $84; 3 comics + 2 magazines cost $54; 2 comics + 2 books cost $52. Find 1 magazine cost.
hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Rearrange the book, magazine, and comic cells exactly as the visual does so that the book-and-comic cells form one matched group.

steps.title: Make the matched book-and-comic group
steps.text: Using the visual model above, The rearranged strips show 3 books plus 3 comics as a group worth $78.

steps.title: Leave only the magazine cells
steps.text: After that group is matched, the 4 magazine cells under the $84-and-$54 strips are worth $60.

steps.title: Share the magazine total equally
steps.text: Each of the 4 identical magazine cells costs $60 ÷ 4 = $15.

en.answerCheck: Check: 4 magazine cells at $15 make $60. Answer: $15.

question: 2 concentric circles have radii 7 cm and 21 cm. Shaded:unshaded area is 2:7. Find unshaded area using π = 22/7.
hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the concentric-circle partition to find the 2 shaded area units first, then scale the 7 unshaded units.

steps.title: Find the ring shown as shaded
steps.text: Large-circle area = 22/7 × 21 × 21 = 1386 cm² and small-circle area = 22/7 × 7 × 7 = 154 cm². The shaded ring is 1386 − 154 = 1232 cm².

steps.title: Value the ratio strip
steps.text: The ring is 2 equal area units in the 2:7 strip, so 1 unit is 1232 ÷ 2 = 616 cm².

steps.title: Read the 7 unshaded units
steps.text: The unshaded portion is 7 × 616 = 4312 cm².

en.answerCheck: Check: 1232:4312 = 2:7 after dividing both terms by 616. Answer: 4312 cm².

steps.title: 读出7个非阴影份
steps.text: 非阴影部分是7 × 616 = 4312 cm²。

question: A 12 cm × 15 cm × 30 cm container became 2/3 full; added tub water left 20% of tub’s original volume. Tub base was 24 cm × 15 cm. Find original water level.
hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Read the prism and 80% tub bar in sequence: the final third of the container is the transferred 80% of the tub water.

steps.title: Find the shaded third of the prism
steps.text: Using the visual model above, The container capacity is 12 × 15 × 30 = 5400 cm³. Its 1 of 3 equal volume slices is 5400 ÷ 3 = 1800 cm³.

steps.title: Complete the 80% capacity bar
steps.text: The 1800 cm³ slice is 80% of the tub's original water, so the full tub-water amount is 1800 ÷ 80 × 100 = 2250 cm³.

steps.title: Convert volume to height
steps.text: The tub base is 24 × 15 = 360 cm². Its original water height is 2250 ÷ 360 = 6.25 cm.

en.answerCheck: Check: 80% of 2250 cm³ is 1800 cm³. Answer: 6.25 cm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 依次读长方体和80%水槽条：容器最后的1/3正是水槽原有水量的80%。

steps.title: 求长方体的1/3
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，容器容量为12 × 15 × 30 = 5400 cm³。3个等体积块中的1块为5400 ÷ 3 = 1800 cm³。

steps.title: 补全80%容量条
steps.text: 1800 cm³是水槽原有水量的80%，所以原有水量为1800 ÷ 80 × 100 = 2250 cm³。

steps.title: 把体积换成水深
steps.text: 水槽底面积是24 × 15 = 360 cm²。原来水深为2250 ÷ 360 = 6.25 cm。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：2250 cm³的80%是1800 cm³。答案：6.25 cm。

steps.text: Six equal rectangles make 864 cm², so each has area 864 ÷ 6 = 144 cm². The top rectangle is 4 equal squares, so each square is 144 ÷ 4 = 36 cm² and has side 6 cm; its length is 4 × 6 = 24 cm.

steps.title: Transfer the labels to figure B
steps.text: Mark every strip thickness as 6 cm, the short step as 12 cm, and the long edges as 24 cm, exactly as on the stepped diagram.

steps.title: Trace the outside only
steps.text: Follow the directional perimeter trace around every exposed edge of figure B. The labelled outside-edge sum shown by the trace is 156 cm.

en.answerCheck: Check: each module rectangle is 24 cm × 6 cm = 144 cm², and 6 such rectangles make 864 cm². Answer: 156 cm.

hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Read the rate card first, then apply its net rate to the labelled 150-minute timeline and the 10 L mini-ratio.

steps.title: Find the net rate
steps.text: The rate card gives 3 L/min − 0.5 L/min = 2.5 L/min.

steps.title: Use the timeline
steps.text: From 7:00 am to 9:30 am is 2 h 30 min = 150 min. The timeline volume is 2.5 × 150 = 375 L.

steps.title: Use the 10 L ratio
steps.text: At 2.5 L each minute, 10 L takes 10 ÷ 2.5 = 4 minutes.

en.answerCheck: Check: 2.5 × 150 = 375 L and 2.5 × 4 = 10 L. Answer: (a) 375 L; (b) 4 minutes.

steps.title: 使用10 L比例
steps.text: 每分钟增加2.5 L，达到10 L需10 ÷ 2.5 = 4 minutes。

question: Orange juice was split A/B/C. 20 ml moved B→C, 210 ml C→A, 150 ml removed A. Final A was 3 times initial A; B=C=3 times final A. Find initial amounts and carton total.
answer: A: 30 ml; B: 290 ml; C: 460 ml; total: 780 ml
hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Read the transfer bars from A's two-unit difference, then use the labelled B and C transfer segments to rebuild the starting volumes.

steps.title: Value A's unit
steps.text: The two-unit difference on A is 210 ml − 150 ml = 60 ml. Therefore 1 unit, A's starting amount, is 60 ÷ 2 = 30 ml.

steps.title: Build B from three A-units
steps.text: B has 3 times final A, shown as 3 × 90 ml = 270 ml, plus the 20 ml sent to C. Thus B initially had 270 + 20 = 290 ml.

steps.title: Undo C's displayed transfers
steps.text: C starts with the 270 ml from B, the 210 ml transfer to A, and the 20 ml adjustment: 270 + 210 − 20 = 460 ml. Total initial juice is 30 + 290 + 460 = 780 ml.

steps.title: 求A的每1份
steps.text: A上的2份差为210 ml − 150 ml = 60 ml。因此1份，即A最初的量，是60 ÷ 2 = 30 ml。

steps.title: 用3个A单位组成B
steps.text: B是最后A的3倍，图上为3 × 90 ml = 270 ml，再加上移到C的20 ml。因此B最初有270 + 20 = 290 ml。

steps.title: 倒推C的转移段
steps.text: C的最初量由来自B的270 ml、转给A的210 ml和20 ml调整段组成：270 + 210 − 20 = 460 ml。最初总量为30 + 290 + 460 = 780 ml。

question: 2 taps add 6 L/min each while a hole drains 8 L per 4 min. A tank is 40% full after 10 min. Find capacity and extra fill time.
hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the inflow/outflow rate table, then read 100 L as the 4 shaded blocks of the 10-block capacity bar.

steps.title: Complete the rate table
steps.text: Using the visual model above, Entering water is 2 × 6 = 12 L/min. Leaving water is 8 ÷ 4 = 2 L/min. The net row is 12 − 2 = 10 L/min.

steps.title: Value the 40% tank bar
steps.text: In 10 minutes the tank gains 10 × 10 = 100 L. The 4 shaded blocks are 40%, so the 10-block full capacity is 100 ÷ 40 × 100 = 250 L.

steps.title: Fill the 6 unshaded blocks
steps.text: The remaining 6 blocks are 250 − 100 = 150 L, which takes 150 ÷ 10 = 15 minutes.

en.answerCheck: Check: 100 L is 40% of 250 L, and 150 L at 10 L/min takes 15 minutes. Answer: (a) 250 L; (b) 15 minutes.

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：100 L是250 L的40%，150 L按10 L/min需15 minutes。答案：(a) 250 L; (b) 15 minutes。

question: Mary had $50, Tom $130. Their mother gave equal daily amounts; after 2 days Mary had 2 times Tom. Find total given and Mary’s daily amount.
hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the two aligned money bars: Mary's 2 units and Tom's 3 units differ by one unit, the original $80 gap.

steps.title: Value the extra unit
steps.text: Tom's starting amount exceeds Mary's by $130 − $50 = $80. The extra third block in Tom's bar is therefore $80.

steps.title: Read Mary's two blocks
steps.text: Mary's final bar has 2 equal blocks, so it is 2 × $80 = $160. The two-day amount she received is $160 − $50 = $110.

steps.title: Split the two-day amount
steps.text: Both received the same $110 over 2 days, so the mother gave $110 + $110 = $220 in total and Mary received $110 ÷ 2 = $55 each day.

en.answerCheck: Check: Mary receives $110 and Tom receives $110, for $220; $110 over 2 days is $55 per day. Answer: (a) $220; (b) $55.

steps.title: 确定多出的1份
steps.text: Tom起初比Mary多$130 − $50 = $80，因此Tom条上多出的第3格是$80。

steps.title: 读出Mary的2格
steps.text: Mary最后的条有2个等格，所以是2 × $80 = $160。她2天收到的钱是$160 − $50 = $110。

steps.title: 把2天金额平分
steps.text: 两人2天各收到相同的$110，因此母亲共给$110 + $110 = $220，Mary每天收到$110 ÷ 2 = $55。

hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the two perimeter-ratio strips to label both squares and their shared shaded rectangle before subtracting the shaded area.

steps.title: Find the square sides from the first ratio strip
steps.text: A:B = 3:5, so 8 units = 192 cm and 1 unit = 24 cm. The square perimeters are 72 cm and 120 cm, giving sides 18 cm and 30 cm.

steps.title: Find the common rectangle
steps.text: The rectangle:A perimeter ratio is 2:6, so its perimeter is 2/6 × 72 = 24 cm. Its length is 18 ÷ 2 = 9 cm and breadth is (24 − 9 − 9) ÷ 2 = 3 cm, so its area is 27 cm².

en.answerCheck: Check: the common rectangle is 9 cm × 3 cm = 27 cm². Answer: (a) 27 cm²; (b) 873 cm²; (c) 1170 cm².

question: Mathew sold 1/3 of pens on day 1, 4 more on day 2, then the rest day 3. Day 2 exceeded day 3 by 15. Find original pens.
hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the 12-cell chronological bar to turn every day into equal units.

steps.title: Label the three parts of the bar
steps.text: The bar shows first day as 1/4 = 3/12, second day as 1/3 + 1/4 = 7/12, and the third day as 12/12 − 3/12 − 7/12 = 2/12.

steps.title: Use the bracketed difference
steps.text: The second-day section has 7 units and the third-day section has 2 units, so their difference is 5 units. The bracket says these 5 units are 15 pens.

steps.title: Scale the full bar
steps.text: One unit is 15 ÷ 5 = 3 pens. All 12 units are 12 × 3 = 36 pens.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用按天排列的12格条，把每天的数量化成相同单位。

steps.title: 利用括号标出的差
steps.text: 第二天有7格，第三天有2格，相差5格。括号说明这5格等于15支笔。

hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

question: Edmund bought small $4, medium $6, large $8 cookie packs. 1/4 were small, medium exceeded small by 4, total was $180. Find each pack count.
hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the 15-unit purchase bar, then convert each coloured section from dollars to packs.

steps.title: Build the 15-unit bar
steps.text: Small packs are 1/3 = 5/15. Medium packs are 1/5 + 5/15 = 8/15, leaving 15 − 5 − 8 = 2 units for large packs.

steps.title: Value one bar unit
steps.text: The complete 15-unit bar costs $180, so 1 unit costs $180 ÷ 15 = $12.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用15格购买组成条，再把每种颜色的金额换成包数。
zh-Hans.answerCheck: 小包装15包；中包装16包；大包装3包。

question: Jim and Alice had marbles. 1/4 of Jim’s count was 1/3 of Alice’s. Jim gave Alice 30; Alice was then 40 ahead; Jim had 2/3 left. Find original counts.
hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Compare the before-and-after marble bars to value one equal unit.

steps.title: Read the two states
steps.text: Before the transfer, the aligned bars show Jim : Alice = 4 : 3. After the transfer, Jim has 5 units and Alice has 6 original units plus 3 transferred units, or 9 units; the gap is 4 units = 40.

steps.title: Value one unit
steps.text: The transfer bracket marks 3 units = 30 marbles, so 1 unit = 30 ÷ 3 = 10 marbles.

steps.title: Return to the original bars
steps.text: Jim’s original bar is 8 units, so 8 × 10 = 80 marbles. Alice’s original bar is 6 units, so 6 × 10 = 60 marbles.

steps.title: 确定每格数量
steps.text: 转移括号标出3格 = 30个弹珠，所以1格 = 30 ÷ 3 = 10个。

steps.title: 回到原有的长条
steps.text: Jim原有的条是8格，所以有8 × 10 = 80个弹珠。Alice原有的条是6格，所以有6 × 10 = 60个弹珠。

question: Cars P, Q, R were 300 km apart at 8:30 am. Q met P at 11:30 am and R 30 min later; P drove 60 km/h. How far did Q travel between meetings?
hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

steps.text: The remaining route segment to the same meeting point is 300 − 180 = 120 km for Q. Thus Q’s speed is 120 ÷ 3 = 40 km/h.

steps.text: The timeline adds 0.5 hour before Q meets R. Q travels 40 × 0.5 = 20 km in that interval.

steps.text: Each half of the route is 480 ÷ 2 = 240 km. The first half at 100 km/h takes 240 ÷ 100 = 2.4 hours.

steps.title: Use the remaining time strip

question: A car takes 5 h and bus 9 h for A→B; car speed is 90 km/h. After 3/5 journey, how much faster must bus travel to arrive 1 h 36 min early?

steps.title: Set the route and original speed
steps.text: The car’s route is 90 × 5 = 450 km. The bus originally takes 9 hours, so its original speed is 450 ÷ 9 = 50 km/h.

steps.title: Read the first 3/5 route section
steps.text: The shaded first 3 of 5 equal parts are 3/5 × 450 = 270 km. At 50 km/h, this section takes 270 ÷ 50 = 5.4 hours.

steps.title: Use the revised time for the final 2/5
steps.text: Arriving 1 h 36 min early changes 9 hours to 9 − 1.6 = 7.4 hours. After 5.4 hours, 2 hours remain for 2/5 × 450 = 180 km, so the new speed is 180 ÷ 2 = 90 km/h. The increase is 90 − 50 = 40 km/h.

en.answerCheck: The bus must travel 40 km/h faster.

steps.title: 读出前3/5路线段
steps.text: 涂出的前5等份中的3份是3/5 × 450 = 270 km。以50 km/h行驶，这一段需要270 ÷ 50 = 5.4小时。

steps.title: 用修订时间计算最后2/5
steps.text: 提前1 h 36 min到达，使9小时变成9 − 1.6 = 7.4小时。已用5.4小时后，剩2小时行驶2/5 × 450 = 180 km，所以新速度是180 ÷ 2 = 90 km/h。提高了90 − 50 = 40 km/h。

question: Collin was 150 m ahead of Bryan; Aaron was 50 m behind Bryan. At 8:00, Aaron passed Bryan in 2 min and Collin 3 min later. Bryan ran 120 m/min. When did Bryan pass Collin?
hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Follow the position track: use the 2-minute catch-up strip for Aaron, the 5-minute strip for Collin, then close the fixed 150 m gap.

steps.title: Read the 2-minute catch-up strip
steps.text: Bryan covers 2 × 120 = 240 m. Aaron starts 50 m behind Bryan, so his aligned strip is 50 + 240 = 290 m in 2 min. Therefore Aaron runs at 290 ÷ 2 = 145 m/min.

steps.title: Read the 5-minute position strip
steps.text: In 5 min, Aaron covers 5 × 145 = 725 m. On the track, remove Collin’s 150 m head start and Aaron’s 50 m starting deficit: 725 − 150 − 50 = 525 m. Thus Collin runs at 525 ÷ 5 = 105 m/min.

steps.title: Close the last gap
steps.text: Bryan gains 120 − 105 = 15 m/min on Collin. The fixed gap is 150 m, so 150 ÷ 15 = 10 min after 8:00, which is 8:10 am.

steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，Bryan 在 2 min 内跑 2 × 120 = 240 m。Aaron 起点在 Bryan 后 50 m，所以对齐后的路程是 50 + 240 = 290 m，用时 2 min。Aaron 的速度是 290 ÷ 2 = 145 m/min。

steps.title: 追完最后的间距
steps.text: Bryan 每分钟追近 120 − 105 = 15 m。固定间距是 150 m，所以 150 ÷ 15 = 10 min；8:00 后 10 min 是 8:10 am。

question: Sean drove 90 km/h from 5:30 to 1:30. Mary made the same trip in 6 h. How far was Sean from the destination when they were 150 km apart?
hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the two aligned journey lanes to find the common 720 km route, then mark the 5-hour point where the lanes are 150 km apart.

steps.title: Label the complete lanes
steps.text: Sean’s lane runs from 5:30 am to 1:30 pm, or 8 h, at 90 km/h. The common route is 90 × 8 = 720 km. Mary’s 6-hour lane therefore has speed 720 ÷ 6 = 120 km/h.

steps.title: Locate the 150 km separation
steps.text: The aligned lanes separate at 120 − 90 = 30 km/h. A 150 km separation occurs after 150 ÷ 30 = 5 h.

steps.title: Shade Sean’s final segment
steps.text: At the 5-hour mark, Sean has 8 − 5 = 3 h left. His shaded final segment is 90 × 3 = 270 km.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用两条对齐的行程线求共同的 720 km 全程，再在 5 h 处标出两条线相距 150 km 的位置。

steps.title: 标出两条完整行程线
steps.text: Sean 的行程线从 5:30 am 到 1:30 pm，共 8 h，速度为 90 km/h。共同全程是 90 × 8 = 720 km。Mary 用 6 h 走完全程，速度为 720 ÷ 6 = 120 km/h。

steps.title: 找到相距 150 km 的时刻
steps.text: 两条对齐行程线每小时拉开 120 − 90 = 30 km。相距 150 km 需要 150 ÷ 30 = 5 h。

steps.title: 读出 Sean 的最后一段
steps.text: 在 5 h 的标记处，Sean 还剩 8 − 5 = 3 h。他到终点的阴影段是 90 × 3 = 270 km。
